zh-Hans: 主窗口新增可调整宽度的右侧预览栏，按方向键即可连续浏览文件。
按空格可打开独立预览窗口，选中文件夹可查看位置与可见项目数。
文件动态卡片会用父目录区分同名文件，浏览大文件夹时切换更流畅。
en: Use the resizable preview pane in the main window and browse files with the arrow keys.
Press Space for a separate preview window, or select a folder to see its location and visible item count.
Activity cards distinguish files with the same name by their parent folders. Switching away from a large folder stops the count.
